surfaces: ee context (soft-deprecated alias, same hydration lane)

trigger.description: A procedural-rule document (source=rule) matched the retrieval query, but the hit could not hydrate into a pack candidate: the rule row could not be loaded, its rule_source_memories linkage could not be read, every linked source-memory id was invalid, or the rule has no source memories at all. Pack candidates are memory-centric, so a rule hit hydrates through a deterministic (lexicographically smallest) source memory; when none is hydratable the pack degrades honestly instead of silently dropping the matched rule. The rule itself remains retrievable via ee search.
setup_commands: ee rule add "Run cargo fmt --check before release." --workspace . --json   # no --source-memory

message_contains: matched search but has no source memories
